item.title: Maruti joins hands with AP Govt; to set up 4 automated driving test tracks in state
item.description: NEW DELHI, Feb 6: Maruti Suzuki India on Friday said it has inked a pact with Andhra Pradesh government for the setting up and maintenance of four automated driving test tracks across the state. The tracks will be set up at four Regional Transport Office (RTO) locations in the state, namely Eluru, Ongole, Vizianagaram, and Anakapalli. item.title: RSS Starts Kashmir To Kanyakumari ‘Dhwaj Yatra’
item.description: Srinagar, Feb 6: The RSS on Friday started a ‘Dhwaj Yatra’ (flag rally) from Kashmir to Kanyakumari to clear the “misgivings” about the outfit. The yatra symbolically began from the historic Lal Chowk and culminated at the Tourist Reception Centre, where the participants boarded vehicles for onward journey to other parts of the country. “The aim of this yatra is to clear the misgivings that the RSS is against some people. item.title: Death toll rises to 13 in bus mishap in western Nepal
item.description: KATHMANDU, Feb 6: The death toll in the Nepal crash when a bus carrying a wedding party met with an accident rose to 13, with five more people succumbing to their injuries. The accident took place in Nepal’s Sudoorpashchim province on Thursday. Eight persons died on the spot and five more succumbed to their injuries during treatment at Dadeldhura Hospital, police were quoted as saying by the Kathmandu Post.
